summary: 本 backlog package 固化 IPD 全阶段优化的双线闭环：流程优化走 WORKFLOW sprint，`IPD-20260611-PLATFORM-001` 作为已完成全链路 proving-ground 基线，后续 Gate A/B/C 的真实验证与产品主线消费对齐 `IPD-20260610-PLATFORM-001`；当前 sprint 先稳定 Gate A，并同时写清 Gate B/C 的后续入口。
decisions: `IPD-20260611-PLATFORM-001` 已完成 `ceo-demand -> delivery` proving-ground replay，后续作为证据基线，不再作为待补跑的 Gate A/B/C 目标。
`IPD-20260610-PLATFORM-001` 固定作为当前 full-scope project-delivery replay / 产品主线消费 case，不再为每轮 replay 新造临时 delivery case。
当前 sprint 先稳定 Gate A：`ceo-demand -> task-dispatch -> discovery -> intelligence -> package/signoff`。
全阶段优化目标保持不变，Gate B 与 Gate C 必须在本轮 backlog 中被显式写出，而不是继续隐含。

outOfScope: building the platform product in this workflow case
claiming later phases already passed live validation
formal host switch or production launch completion

prioritizedBacklog.title: 固化 Gate A replay 合同
doneWhen: ceo-demand 到 intelligence 的 replay 顺序固定

prioritizedBacklog.title: 写清 rollback 与自测矩阵
doneWhen: ceo-demand、task-dispatch、discovery 三个主回退锚点规则明确
source-side 自测先于 live replay 成为硬约束

prioritizedBacklog.title: 固化 Discovery 竞品 carry-forward 合同
doneWhen: CEO 填槽的 competitorReference 不再被视为唯一竞品上限，但每个 seeded competitor 都必须进入后续 Discovery 引用，除非有显式 waiver 理由
Discovery 自动生成 catalog / brief / landscape 前，会校验 seeded competitor 是否全部被覆盖
若 Discovery 引用扩展出更多竞品，不阻断；但 seeded competitor 缺失时必须阻断 submit 或标记 revision-required

prioritizedBacklog.title: 形成 Gate B / Gate C capability map
doneWhen: designing 到 verify-integration 的逐段放行条件明确
redteam 到 delivery 的逐段放行条件明确

prioritizedBacklog.title: 生成 sprint-planning 计划包
doneWhen: 给出 sprint goal、任务顺序和验证节点
明确下一轮 replay 前必须完成的 source-side check

prioritizedBacklog.title: 把流程代码修改默认路由给 CTO
doneWhen: 总助只负责 contract、acceptance 和 handoff，不再常态代替 CTO 修改 Discovery 自动化实现
任何涉及 runtime / CLI / validator 的流程严谨性补丁，默认先落到 CTO 的 sprint-execution 责任面

entryCriteriaForNextStage: sprint-planning package can translate backlog into executable tasks
risks: The proving-ground may drift if Gate A/B/C validation does not stay aligned to IPD-20260610-PLATFORM-001.
The optimization goal may collapse back to D/I-only language if Gate B/C are not kept explicit.
Replay confidence will stay low if source-side self-test is not enforced before each live run.
Seeded competitors may disappear silently if competitorReference is not treated as a carry-forward contract.
CTO ownership will stay blurred if workflow code patches continue to be done ad hoc by CEOChiefOfStaff.
